about: Colchester Subdivision C is a county subdivision in Colchester County, Nova Scotia—rural territory around and apart from the separate Town of Truro, covering countryside, shore, and hamlets rather than a single city. Farms, forest, and Minas Basin approaches share the landscape of central Nova Scotia’s Hub County. About 13,000 people live in Colchester Subd. C.
seoSummary: Colchester County subdivision of rural hamlets and farms around Truro—not the Town of Truro itself, not a city.
